# teams_update_management_policy (Resource)

Manages the UpdateManagementPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsUpdateManagementPolicy / Get-CsTeamsUpdateManagementPolicy / Set-CsTeamsUpdateManagementPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsUpdateManagementPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `allow_managed_updates` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowManagedUpdates parameter.
- `allow_preview` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowPreview parameter.
- `allow_public_preview` (String) Maps to the -AllowPublicPreview parameter.
- `block_legacy_authorization` (Boolean) Maps to the -BlockLegacyAuthorization parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `disabled_in_product_messages` (String) Maps to the -DisabledInProductMessages parameter.
- `update_day_of_week` (Number) Maps to the -UpdateDayOfWeek parameter.
- `update_time` (String) Maps to the -UpdateTime parameter.
- `update_time_of_day` (String) Maps to the -UpdateTimeOfDay parameter.
- `use_new_teams_client` (String) Maps to the -UseNewTeamsClient parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
